card.name: Start of my- medical terms
card.fires_on: The word piece "my" that begins terms like myelosuppressive, myopathy, myeloid and mycophenolate, after words such as of, as, with or to. A weaker response also appears on "to" and "than" in drug interaction or exposure comparisons.
